what: The identity mode for self-contained files (tools/lean-intake.js, 2026-11-10), tested on a recorded case: AlphaProof Nexus's proof of Erdős #12, part (ii), against DeepMind's statement in formal-conjectures at the commit the results repository builds against. The results file restates the canonical definition IsGood in the canonical namespace Erdos12, so the two files cannot be loaded into one environment (the L3 scout's finding, corpus/targets.json lean-intake-apn-statement-layer-2026-11). The proof itself is already decided: certs/apn-kernel.json (2026-10-20) records it CERTIFIED by Comparator with nanoda, against the same statement, on a hosted runner. The question here is the tool's: does the new mode reach that answer, and does it still refuse a wrong statement and a planted defect. This spec is hand-written and is the pre-registration, committed before the run.
